headline: WNBA Semifinals: Dream and Cinderella Valkyries advance to 2026 Finals
whyCareReason: After thrilling Game 3 home wins kept their seasons alive, New York and Las Vegas host Game 4 trailing 1-2 in best-of-five semifinals.
teaser: Sunday double-header: Dream at Liberty (3:00 p.m. ET, ABC) and Valkyries at Aces (5:30 p.m. ET, ESPN).
story: The WNBA crowned two new conference champions on Sunday as both semifinal series concluded in 3-1 upsets. In Brooklyn, the Atlanta Dream eliminated the defending champion New York Liberty 85-83 behind 24 points from Rhyne Howard and 16 rebounds from Angel Reese. In Las Vegas, the expansion Golden State Valkyries made sports history, outlasting the Las Vegas Aces 87-83 in overtime to become the first expansion franchise in professional basketball history to reach the Finals in year one.
stakes: Wins for Dream and Valkyries crown new conference champions. Wins for Liberty and Aces force deciding Game 5 clashes on Tuesday.
rivalryAngle: Championship DNA versus unprecedented underdog momentum across two electric home arenas.
funFacts: Only four teams in WNBA history have ever rallied from an 0-2 deficit to force a deciding Game 5.
A'ja Wilson's 31 points in Game 3 marked her tenth career 30-point playoff outing.
The Golden State Valkyries are aiming to become the first expansion team in professional basketball history to reach a finals in year one.

keyPlayers.name: A'ja Wilson
keyPlayers.hook: Carrying the two-time champions with dominant inside-outside play.

headToHead: Atlanta and Golden State both lead their respective series 2-1 heading into Sunday's Game 4s.
resultSummary: FINAL: Dream 85-83 Liberty (Atlanta wins series 3-1) · Valkyries 87-83 Aces OT (Golden State wins series 3-1)
